en.headline: Police seek two men after Yau Ma Tei car hits three vehicles
en.dek: A private car fled a restricted-zone stop on Nathan Road on Monday afternoon, striking two cars and a taxi; an officer was hurt trying to smash a window and the vehicle was later found abandoned in Hung Hom.
body: Police are looking for two men after a private car drove off during a stop in Yau Ma Tei on Monday afternoon, hitting three vehicles and injuring an officer.

Uniformed officers from the Mong Kok patrol subunit said they found the car parked in a no-stopping zone near Nathan Road and Hamilton Street at about 4.49pm. Officers said the two men inside refused to cooperate and the driver sped away towards Tsim Sha Tsui. During the escape the car struck a private car at Hamilton Street, a taxi near Man Ming Lane, and a seven-seater on Gascoigne Road.

A Police Tactical Unit officer trying to smash a window to stop the car injured his hand and was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital. A passenger in one of the vehicles that was hit reported chest pain and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Officers later found the abandoned car, a black Mercedes-Benz, on Yan Yung Street in Hung Hom near a student hostel. The driver was not there.

Police classified the case as reckless driving and possession of a Part I poison and assigned it to the Yau Tsim regional crime unit. No one had been arrested by early Tuesday. Police said they were tracing the registered owner.

zh.headline: 油麻地私家車拒查連撞三車 警追緙兩男
zh.dek: 一輛私家車周一傍晚在彌敦道限制區落客遇查後逃走，先後撞及兩輛私家車及一輛的士，一名警員扑窗時受傷，車輛其後在紅磡被發現，車內無人。
body: 警方正追緙兩名男子。一輛私家車周一傍晚在油麻地被截查時開走，連撞三車，並導致一名警員受傷。
旺角警區軍裝巡邏小隊表示，下午約4晈49分在彌敦道近咸美頓街發現該車停在禁止停車處，上前截查。車上兩名男子拒絕合作，司機隨即往尖沙咀方向逃走。逃逸期間，車輛先後在咸美頓街撞及一輛私家車、在文明里附近撞及一輛的士，以及在加士居道撞及一輛七人車。
一名機動部隊警員嘗試扑破車窗截停時傷及手部，由救護車送往廣華醫院。其中一輛被撞車輛的乘客報稱心口不適，送往伊利沙伯醫院。警方其後在紅磡仁勇街近學生宿舍尋獲涉案黑色平治，車內空無一人。
案件列作狂亂駕駛及管有第一部毒藥，交由油尖警區重案組跟進。截至週二清晨未有人被捕。警方表示正根據車輛登記資料聯絡車主。
